title: NEUROGUT -- Gut-Brain Axis Diagnostic Platform
summary: A full-stack platform providing AI-powered clinical decision support that predicts depression and anxiety from gut microbiome composition, using a stacked RF/XGBoost/LR classifier. Its planning documents describe using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit via SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic microbiome test samples in place of unshareable clinical data.
